listings.name: Stylistics Hair Studio
listings.current_description: Stylistics Hair Studio is a hairdressing salon and training centre in Heathfield that also offers nail services, with laser hair removal planned as a future addition.

listings.name: The Avenue Restaurant and Grill
listings.current_description: The Avenue Restaurant and Grill is a family-run steakhouse and grill in Harfield Village, Claremont, also offering a dedicated vegan and vegetarian menu and live music.

listings.name: The Best Laser & Skin
listings.current_description: The Best Laser & Skin is a beauty and skin-care clinic at 25 Derry Street in Vredehoek, offering laser hair removal and skin treatments by appointment.

listings.name: The Body Shop

listings.name: The Clarendon Boutique Hotel
listings.current_description: The Clarendon Boutique Hotel is a family-run, 16-room heritage guesthouse in Fresnaye established in 1996, with dual swimming pools overlooking Clifton Bay and breakfast served daily.

listings.name: The Crazy Store
listings.current_description: The Crazy Store at Mountain View Shopping Centre is a discount variety store on Avondrus Street in Gordon's Bay selling household goods, toys, stationery and gifts.

listings.current_description: The Designer Warehouse Emporium is a factory-shop clothing and accessories store for babies, boys, girls, ladies and gents, trading since 2008, on Voortrekker Road in Maitland.

listings.name: The Party Shop
listings.current_description: The Party Shop is a party supply and decor shop in Portlands, Mitchells Plain, offering themed party decorations and supplies for children's parties and other occasions.

listings.name: The Village Bicycle
listings.current_description: The Village Bicycle is a popular wood-fired pizzeria and grill in Harfield Village, also serving burgers, ribs, tapas, pasta, salads and desserts in a family-friendly setting.

listings.name: Tiger's Milk
listings.current_description: Tiger's Milk Green Point is a branch of the South African restaurant chain known for burgers, grills and pizza paired with its own Tiger's Milk Lager.

listings.name: Tiger's Milk
listings.current_description: Tiger's Milk Muizenberg is a pizza, grill and burger restaurant on Beach Road, with a daily happy hour from 4-6pm and live music on Sunday evenings.

listings.name: Tile Factory Shop
listings.current_description: Tile Factory Shop is a building-materials retailer in Elsies River Industrial selling tiles, mosaics, cladding and paint, including porcelain, matte, satin, glazed and large-format tile ranges.

listings.name: Truworths
listings.current_description: Truworths at The Junxion Mall in Philippi is a branch of the Cape Town-founded fashion retail chain, offering women's leisurewear, formalwear, lingerie, jewellery, shoes and accessories.

listings.name: Vagabond Kitchens
listings.current_description: Vagabond Kitchens is an all-day cafe in Sea Point serving burgers, tapas, and vegan and vegetarian dishes, with a weekday happy hour on tapas and coffee.

listings.name: Value Co
listings.current_description: Value Co at Longbeach Mall in Noordhoek is a large general dealer store selling home decor, homeware, beauty products, jewellery and DIY items across multiple departments.

listings.name: weClean
listings.current_description: weClean is a family-owned, owner-managed cleaning company serving Richwood and the wider Cape Town area, offering office and commercial cleaning alongside carpet, upholstery and mattress cleaning.

listings.name: Wellness Warehouse
listings.current_description: Wellness Warehouse is a health and wellness retailer stocking supplements, natural skincare and wholefoods, trading from its store on the first floor of Lifestyle on Kloof.

listings.name: West Coast Fisheries Milnerton
listings.current_description: West Coast Fisheries Milnerton is a seafood takeaway on Koeberg Road serving fish and chips, calamari, burgers, ribs and gatsbys, along with fresh snoek and hake.

listings.name: Whitney's Hair & Beauty Boutique
listings.current_description: Whitney's Hair & Beauty Boutique is a hair and beauty salon inside Kromboom Convenience Centre in Crawford, offering hairstyling, colour and treatments such as hair botox.

listings.name: Wimpy
listings.current_description: Wimpy at Strand Square is a branch of the national family-restaurant chain, serving breakfasts, burgers and light meals from its Shop 1 unit on Mills Street.

listings.name: Yumcious
listings.current_description: Yumcious is a bistro-style restaurant inside Cape Quarter in De Waterkant, serving a pay-by-weight selection of hot dishes that changes daily, alongside burgers, sandwiches and milkshakes.

listings.name: Absolute Pets
listings.current_description: Absolute Pets is a branch of the South African pet supply retail chain, stocking pet food, accessories and supplies inside Cape Quarter Lifestyle Village in De Waterkant.

listings.name: Absolute Pets
listings.current_description: Absolute Pets Kenridge is a branch of the national pet supplies retail chain, stocking pet food, accessories and grooming products from Shop 8 in IPIC Shopping Centre.

listings.name: Alpine Primary School
listings.current_description: Alpine Primary School is a no-fee public primary school in Beacon Valley, Mitchells Plain, governed as a Section 21 school whose governing body manages its own budget.

listings.name: BangBang Vintage
listings.current_description: BangBang Vintage Market is a multi-trader vintage concept store in Observatory housing around a dozen independent traders selling thrifted clothing, steampunk pieces, festival wear and alternative fashion.

listings.name: Bidvest Waltons Brackenfell Corner
listings.current_description: Bidvest Waltons Brackenfell Corner is a stationery and office-supplies store stocking a wide range of office furniture, stationery and tech accessories, in Brackenfell Corner shopping centre, Brackenfell.

listings.name: Biesmiellah
listings.current_description: Biesmiellah is a family-run, strictly halaal restaurant in Bo-Kaap that has served traditional Cape Malay dishes such as bredies, denningvleis and bobotie for more than four decades.

listings.name: Bird & Co Kromboom
listings.current_description: Bird & Co Kromboom is a branch of the South African fast-food chain known for deboned chicken and wood-fired pizza, operating from Kromboom Convenience Centre in Crawford.

listings.name: Bistro Sixteen82
listings.current_description: Bistro Sixteen82 is a contemporary tapas and bistro restaurant on the Steenberg Wine Estate, serving breakfast, lunch and tapas-style dinner with views over the vineyards and mountains.

listings.name: Bo-Kaap Deli
listings.current_description: Bo-Kaap Deli is a neighbourhood cafe and deli on Church Street blending Cape Malay influences with modern comfort food, known for its koeksisters, artisanal breads and coffee.

listings.name: Bootlegger Coffee Company
listings.current_description: Bootlegger Coffee Company is a specialty coffee shop in Brackenfell Corner, Brackenfell, offering all-day breakfast, brunch and lunch alongside coffee, toasties and pastries for dine-in or takeaway.

listings.name: Bootlegger Coffee Company
listings.current_description: Bootlegger Coffee Company's Tokai branch is an all-day cafe at Forest Glade House on Tokai Road, serving breakfast through dinner alongside an after-dark tapas and cocktail menu.

listings.name: Bootlegger Coffee Company
listings.current_description: Bootlegger Coffee Company is a Cape Town coffee shop chain serving all-day breakfast, brunch and coffee, with this branch trading from The Point mall in Sea Point.

listings.name: Cafe Manhattan
listings.current_description: Cafe Manhattan is a longstanding LGBTQI+ bar and kitchen in the heart of De Waterkant village, serving stone-baked pizzas, burgers and small plates for over thirty years.

listings.name: Cash Converters Kuils River
listings.current_description: Cash Converters Kuils River buys and sells second-hand goods such as electronics, cellphones, tools and household items, and offers short-term cash loans against valuables, in Kuils River.

listings.current_description: Cash Crusaders Eerste River is a second-hand goods and pawnbroking store in the Maxi Centre, Eerste River, buying and selling used electronics, tools, and other pre-owned items.

listings.name: Cash Crusaders Kuilsriver
listings.current_description: Cash Crusaders Kuilsriver is a second-hand goods and pawnbroking store in River Park Shopping Centre, Kuils River, buying and selling used electronics, tools and other everyday items.

listings.name: Cash Crusaders Lansdowne
listings.current_description: Cash Crusaders Lansdowne is a branch of Cash Crusaders, a Cape Town-founded (1996) secondhand retail chain buying, selling and pawning electronics, tools, appliances and other used goods.

listings.name: Chops Biltong
listings.current_description: Chops Biltong at Riverlands Mall sells traditional South African biltong -- beef and game, in slices, sticks and chips -- along with droewors, nuts and dried fruit.

listings.name: Clicks Goodwood Mall
listings.current_description: Clicks Goodwood Mall is a pharmacy and health, beauty and personal-care retailer inside Goodwood Mall, offering prescription dispensing alongside its usual range of over-the-counter medicines and toiletries.

listings.name: Clicks
listings.current_description: Clicks is a pharmacy, health and beauty retailer with a store inside Capricorn Square in Muizenberg, offering a dispensary, personal care products and its ClubCard loyalty programme.

listings.name: Clicks Pharmacy Welgemoed
listings.current_description: Clicks Pharmacy Welgemoed is a branch of the Clicks pharmacy, health and beauty retail chain in Welgemoed Forum, combining a dispensary with health, beauty and toiletry products.

listings.name: Col'Cacchio GO
listings.current_description: Col'Cacchio GO is a fast-casual, takeaway-focused outpost of the Col'Cacchio pizza chain in the Old Biscuit Mill, serving wood-fired pizzas, pastas and salads for collection or delivery.

listings.name: Copper Club Plattekloof
listings.current_description: Copper Club Plattekloof is a bar and restaurant in Plattekloof Shopping Centre known for burgers, cheesesteaks and other casual American-style dishes, with beers on tap and cocktails.

listings.name: Crema Design
listings.current_description: Crema Design is a furniture and lifestyle showroom in Woodstock, showcasing international designer lighting, rugs, and indoor/outdoor furniture in a restored Victorian building dating to 1889.

listings.name: Danneberg Optometrist
listings.current_description: Danneberg Optometrist has operated in Cape Town since 1987, providing comprehensive eye exams, contact lens fittings, retinal photography and glaucoma screening from its store in Riverside Mall.

listings.name: Dawn Asian Restaurant
listings.current_description: Dawn Asian Restaurant is an upmarket Chinese restaurant in the Cape Quarter Lifestyle Centre in De Waterkant, known for dim sum, Peking duck and Asian fusion dishes.

listings.name: Dawood Butchery
listings.current_description: Dawood Butchery is a halaal butchery in Delft, part of a business that has served Cape Town communities with affordable, quality meat for more than 50 years.

listings.name: De Kock Estates
listings.current_description: De Kock Estates is an estate agency in Fish Hoek that has served the False Bay area for over 50 years, handling residential property sales and rentals.
